hooks.command:
: 'Git Push to Main Approval'
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""')
push='git( +(-[Cc] +[^ ]+|-[^ ]+))* +push'
echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|( ])$push" || exit 0
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null
br=$(git symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null)
segments=$(echo "$cmd" | grep -oE "$push[^;&|]*" | sed -E "s/^$push//; s/[0-9]*[<>].*$//" | tr -d "\"')")
set -f
ask=false
while IFS= read -r args; do
  n=0
  for t in $args; do
    case "$t" in --all|--mirror) ask=true; continue ;; -*) continue ;; esac
    n=$((n + 1))
    [ "$n" -eq 1 ] && continue
    t=${t#+}
    dst=${t##*:}
    dst=${dst##*/}
    case "$dst" in main|master) ask=true ;; esac
    case "$br:$dst" in main:HEAD|master:HEAD) ask=true ;; esac
  done
  case "$br" in main|master) [ "$n" -lt 2 ] && ask=true ;; esac
done <<EOF
$segments
EOF
if [ "$ask" = true ]; then
  jq -n --arg c "$cmd" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:("This pushes to main/master: " + $c + " - approve only if you really want that.")}}'
fi
exit 0

jq -c '(.tool_input // {}) as $t | (($t.issueType // $t.issuetype // "") | ascii_downcase) as $type | ($t.summary // "") as $s | ($t.description // "") as $d | if $type != "bug" then empty else [ (if ($s | test("^\\[(HDR|HOME|EXP|CHEF|DISH|CART|AUTH|CHK|OST|ORD|TRK|XC|API)\\] .+")) then empty else "Summary must start with a component code, e.g. [CHK] ..." end), (if ($s | length) > 100 then "Summary is \($s | length) chars (max 100)" else empty end), (if ($s | test("doesn.?t work|not working|broken|issue with"; "i")) then "Summary must say what is wrong, not broken or does not work" else empty end), (["Environment","Steps to reproduce","Actual result","Expected result","Reproducibility"][] as $sec | if ($d | ascii_downcase | contains($sec | ascii_downcase)) then empty else "Missing section: \($sec)" end), (if ($d | test("Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}|eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\\.")) then "Remove the auth token from the description" else empty end) ] as $p | {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: (if ($p | length) > 0 then "deny" else "ask" end), permissionDecisionReason: (if ($p | length) > 0 then "Bug report breaks foodme-storefront-bug-reports rules: " + ($p | join("; ")) else "Review this Jira bug before it is created." end)}} end'

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '(test-case|testcase|test_case)[^/]*\.(md|csv)$' || exit 0; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; ids=$(grep -oE 'SF-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+' "$f"); bad=$(echo "$ids" | grep -vE '^$|^SF-(HDR|HOME|EXP|CHEF|DISH|CART|AUTH|CHK|OST|ORD|TRK|XC)-[0-9]{3}$' | sort -u | tr '
' ' '); dups=$(echo "$ids" | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -d | tr '
' ' '); vague=$(grep -niE 'works (correctly|as expected|fine)|error (is )?(shown|displayed|appears)|(^|[^a-z])etc([^a-z]|$)' "$f" | cut -c1-120); msg=''; [ -z "$ids" ] && msg="$msg- No test case IDs found (expected SF-<MODULE>-<NNN>)
"; [ -n "$bad" ] && msg="$msg- Invalid IDs: $bad
"; [ -n "$dups" ] && msg="$msg- Duplicate IDs: $dups
"; [ -n "$vague" ] && msg="$msg- Vague wording, quote exact UI text instead:
$vague
"; [ -z "$msg" ] && exit 0; printf 'Test cases in %s break foodme-storefront-test-cases rules:
%b' "$f" "$msg" >&2; exit 2
